title: MuroStaffChat
description: Adds a Staff & Manager to your server!
body:
# **MuroStaffChat**


A very lightweight Staff & Manager Chat plugin. Extremely customisable and very lightweight. Coded in Kotlin.

Folia Supported



## Key Features

- Toggle-able Chat - Able to toggle in and out of Staff & Manager chat.
- Join Messages - Let's other staff member when you come online.
- Reporting - Report rule breakers to the staff team whether they are online or not!
- Action Bar messages - When staff or manager chat is enabled there is a action bar message that is constant until you're back in normal chat.
- Lightweight - Made with server performance in mind


## Need Support or Have Questions?
We are dedicated to providing fast updates and helpful support. If you encounter any bugs or have a feature request, don't hesitate to reach out!


## Commands
Command Permission Description
- /sc - Sending /sc by itself will toggle into staff chat, Send a message after for a single message.
- /screport - This will send a report to the staff team, Nobody online? It will send it into a mail system to notify them when they get online!
- /sctoggle - This will toggle whether staff chat messages come through or not.
- /screload - Admin command for reloading the configuration.
- /scm - Sending /scm by itself will toggle into Manager chat, Send a message after for a single message.
- /scmtoggle - This will toggle whether Manager chat messages come through or not.

## Permissions
- staffchat.use - View, send, and toggle staff chat (/sc); see staff join/leave messages.
- staffchat.report - Report a user to the staff team.
- staffchat.toggle - Mute/unmute incoming staff chat (/sctoggle).
- managerchat.use -
- View, send, and toggle manager chat (/scm).
- managerchat.toggle - Mute/unmute incoming manager chat (/scmtoggle).
- staffchat.admin - Reload the configuration (/staffchatreload).
